2610.03591.title: HazardWeaver: Scientific Route Selection for Hazard Analysis Agents
2610.03591.paper_summary: Understanding and assessing natural hazards is essential for disaster preparedness and risk reduction. Recent advances in large language models have spurred growing interest in AI agents for hazard analysis, particularly their ability to integrate scientific data, models, and tools into automated workflows. However, effective automation requires agents to determine which scientific methods are appropriate for a given event and executable with the available data and tools. As new evidence and execution results become available, these conditions can change, requiring agents to reconsider their choices. We formulate this problem as state-dependent scientific route selection and introduce HazardWeaver. Specifically, HazardWeaver first leverages the Hazard Knowledge Compiler to extract evidence-linked conditions governing scientific applicability, then its Hazard Capability Graph represents executable scientific capabilities and checks compatibility between their inputs and outputs. Using these complementary representations, the Hazard Weaver Agent component selects applicable and executable routes, carries out their workflows, and revises its decisions as the analysis state changes. To evaluate both the scientific outputs and the decisions that produce them, we introduce the Hazard Weaver Benchmark, comprising 141 instances across seven single-hazard domains and four multi-hazard interaction classes. The benchmark accommodates multiple valid scientific routes and evaluates output correctness, route validity, and justified abstention. Extensive experiments on this benchmark show that HazardWeaver outperforms existing agent systems, with the largest gains on tasks with multiple eligible scientific routes. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/HazardWeaver.
2610.03591.paper_summary_zh: 理解和評估自然災害對於災難準備和風險減少至關重要。最近在大型語言模型方面的進展引發了對於AI代理在災害分析中的興趣，特別是它們將科學數據、模型和工具整合到自動化工作流程中的能力。然而，有效的自動化要求代理能夠確定哪些科學方法適用於特定事件，並且可以使用可用的數據和工具執行。隨著新證據和執行結果的出現，這些條件可能會改變，要求代理重新考慮其選擇。我們將這個問題表述為狀態依賴的科學路徑選擇，並引入HazardWeaver。具體而言，HazardWeaver首先利用Hazard Knowledge Compiler提取與證據相關的條件，這些條件決定了科學的適用性，然後其Hazard Capability Graph表示可執行的科學能力，並檢查其輸入和輸出之間的兼容性。利用這些互補的表示，Hazard Weaver Agent組件選擇適用且可執行的路徑，執行其工作流程，並在分析狀態變化時修正其決策。為了評估科學輸出及其產生的決策，我們引入了Hazard Weaver Benchmark，該基準包括七個單一災害領域和四個多災害互動類別的141個實例。該基準容納多條有效的科學路徑，並評估輸出正確性、路徑有效性和合理的放棄。對該基準的廣泛實驗顯示，HazardWeaver在現有代理系統中表現優越，尤其在具有多個合格科學路徑的任務中獲得了最大的增益。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/LabRAI/HazardWeaver 上公開獲得。
